idf_component_register(
    SRCS "app_main.c"
    INCLUDE_DIRS "."
    # NOTE (Task 1 drift): board_devkit_v1 is omitted from REQUIRES until Task 2 creates it
    # (components/drivers/board_devkit_v1 is not yet in EXTRA_COMPONENT_DIRS either -- see the
    # top-level CMakeLists.txt note). app_main does not call board_* yet, so this is safe.
    REQUIRES core esp_system app lt_hal nvs_flash esp_timer esp_hw_support)

# build_config.h is generated by the top-level CMakeLists.txt into the build tree (§21.1).
target_include_directories(${COMPONENT_LIB} PRIVATE "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}")
